description: Fetch the account's configuration: contact and job workflows with their statuses, task types, activity (note) types, file types and lead sources. Use it to find the exact record_type_name / status_name / source_name values the create and update tools need. Pass field (e.g. groups) to get just one setting. JobNimbus: GET /account/settings.

field.description: Return only this setting, e.g. groups.

name: jobnimbus_get_account_settings
title: Get account settings
